appreciation.en: Chrysanthemums fill the yard in the west wind, too cold and fragrant for butterflies to visit. If he were ever lord of spring, the poet says, he would let them bloom alongside the peach blossoms.

famous: 秋風不相待，先至洛陽城。

appreciation.zh-CN: 归期误了，秋风却不等人，先到洛阳，构思新巧，含蓄有趣。
appreciation.en: The traveler had planned his return to the day, but was delayed. The autumn wind did not wait for him and reached Luoyang first.

famous: 竹憐新雨後，山愛夕陽時。
titleEn: My Study at the Valley Mouth

appreciation.zh-CN: 茅屋泉壑间，雨后翠竹、夕照青山，秋花迟落，幽居清美。
appreciation.en: A thatched study sits among springs and gullies wrapped in cloud. Bamboo is loveliest after fresh rain and the hills at sunset, while egrets roost early and autumn flowers fade late.

famous: 懸燈千嶂夕，卷幔五湖秋。
titleEn: Staying in the Pavilion of Yunmen Temple

appreciation.zh-CN: 高阁悬灯，千峰入夜，卷帘望见五湖秋色，仿佛离天很近。
appreciation.en: In the temple pavilion a lamp hangs over a thousand darkening peaks, and rolling up the curtain reveals the autumn of the Five Lakes. It feels so close to heaven that he dreams of drifting with white clouds.

famous: 秋水纔深四五尺，野航恰受兩三人。

appreciation.zh-CN: 邻家隐士好客，孩子欢喜、鸟雀亲人，秋水小舟、月下相送，温暖恬淡。
appreciation.en: Du Fu visits a hermit neighbor whose children welcome guests and whose birds peck tamely at the steps. The autumn stream is only a few feet deep, the little boat holds just two or three, and they part at the gate under a new moon.

famous: 一年好景君須記，正是橙黄橘綠時。

appreciation.zh-CN: 荷尽菊残，却说一年好景正在橙黄橘绿时，乐观豁达，勉励友人。
appreciation.en: The lotus leaves are gone and only the chrysanthemum stems still stand up to frost. Yet Su Shi tells his friend to remember this: the best scenery of the year is when oranges turn yellow and tangerines are still green.

famous: 笑歌聲裏輕雷動，一夜連枷響到明。

appreciation.zh-CN: 霜晴打稻，笑声歌声伴着连枷声响彻通宵，丰收的喜悦扑面而来。
appreciation.en: Newly packed threshing floors are smooth as mirrors, and every family threshes rice in the clear frosty weather. Amid laughter and song the flails thunder all night until dawn.

famous: 細擣棖虀買鱠魚，西風吹上四腮鱸。

appreciation.zh-CN: 西风起时松江鲈鱼正肥，捣好橙齑切成鱼脍，鲜美之味跃然纸上。
appreciation.en: When the west wind blows, the famous four-gilled perch of the Song River come up. Sliced fine and served with orange relish, they are a taste found nowhere else.

famous: 穫稻畢工隨曬穀，直須晴到入倉時。

appreciation.zh-CN: 秋收时节盼晴天，割完稻谷就晾晒，只愿晴到入仓，写尽农家心愿。
appreciation.en: At harvest the farmers fear only long rains and pray for cloudless days. Once the rice is cut it goes straight out to dry, and they hope the sun holds until it is all in the barn.

famous: 杞菊垂珠滴露紅，兩蛩相應語莎叢。

appreciation.zh-CN: 枸杞红、菊挂露，蟋蟀对唱，秋日田园小景细腻宁静。
appreciation.en: Goji berries and chrysanthemums hang heavy with dew and two crickets answer each other in the grass. Spider silk covers the hollyhock leaves as tall flowers bend in the evening breeze.

famous: 落木千山天遠大，澄江一道月分明。

appreciation.zh-CN: 公事办完登阁看晚晴，千山落木、天高地阔，澄江映月，胸怀顿开。
appreciation.en: Done with official business, the poet climbs the pavilion in the evening light. Leaves have fallen from a thousand hills, the sky is vast, and the clear river carries a bright band of moonlight.

famous: 青山繚繞疑無路，忽見千帆隠映來。

appreciation.zh-CN: 秋阴半开，青山环绕似已无路，忽然千帆隐现而来，境界豁然开朗。
appreciation.en: Autumn clouds over the river half part while evening clouds hang heavy with rain. Green hills wind round until there seems no way through, then suddenly a thousand sails appear.

famous: 知有兒童挑促織，夜深籬落一燈明。

appreciation.zh-CN: 梧叶萧萧的秋夜，篱边一点灯光，原来是孩子们在捉蟋蟀，童趣盎然。
appreciation.en: Parasol leaves rustle in the cold autumn wind. Late at night a single lamp shines by the hedge: children are out catching crickets.

famous: 隔斷紅塵三十里，白雲紅葉兩悠悠。

appreciation.zh-CN: 清溪碧山，水天一色，远离尘嚣，白云红叶悠然自在，清净超脱。
appreciation.en: A clear stream runs past green hills, and water and sky share one autumn color. Thirty li from the dusty world, white clouds and red leaves drift along at their ease.

famous: 道人不是悲秋客，一任晚山相對愁。

appreciation.zh-CN: 白苹吹尽，楚江秋深，诗人却说自己不悲秋，任晚山去愁，洒脱豁达。
appreciation.en: Coming and going as he pleases, the poet sees the white duckweed blown away on the autumn river. He is no man to grieve over autumn; let the evening hills do the sighing.

famous: 水心雲影閑相照，林下泉聲静自來。

appreciation.zh-CN: 秋气中漫步堤上，云影映水、泉声自来，世事不计，只约佳日再游。
appreciation.en: Strolling the embankment as autumn changes all things, the poet opens a cup of wine in the evening cool. Cloud shadows rest on the water and spring sounds drift from the woods; why worry about the world?

famous: 菰蒲深處疑無地，忽有人家笑語聲。

appreciation.zh-CN: 霜夜行船，寒星满天，菰蒲深处忽传笑语，静中有暖，意趣盎然。
appreciation.en: Frost settles on the clear canal and countless cold stars glitter beside the boat. Deep in the wild rice it seems there is no land at all, until laughter rises from a hidden household.

famous: 風定小軒無落葉，青蟲相對吐秋絲。

appreciation.zh-CN: 煮茶读书，教儿诵词，风停叶静，青虫吐丝，秋日书斋安宁闲适。
appreciation.en: After brewing tea in a flowered cup, the poet calls his son to recite the Songs of Chu. The wind has stopped, no leaves fall by the little study, and green caterpillars spin their autumn silk.

famous: 日長似歲閑方覺，事大如山醉亦休。

appreciation.zh-CN: 看淡名利，自比江湖沙鸥，闲中觉日长，醉里万事休，旷达自适。
appreciation.en: Others are driven by greed like stampeding oxen; the poet is a gull drifting on rivers and lakes. Idle, he feels a day as long as a year, and with wine even mountain-sized troubles can rest.

famous: 萬壑有聲含晚籟，數峰無語立斜陽。

appreciation.zh-CN: 菊初黄时信马山行，万壑风声、数峰斜阳，棠梨红、荞麦白，秋色如画。
appreciation.en: Riding through the hills as chrysanthemums turn yellow, the poet hears the valleys hum at dusk while silent peaks stand in the setting sun. Pear leaves fall red as rouge and buckwheat blooms white as snow.

famous: 蕭蕭遠樹疏林外，一半秋山带夕陽。
titleEn: Written on a Riverside Pavilion Wall

appreciation.zh-CN: 凭栏望远，江阔帆稀，远树萧疏，半边秋山染着夕阳，画面开阔。
appreciation.en: Leaning on the railing over the broad river with few sails in sight, the poet gazes far. Beyond the sparse woods, half the autumn hills glow in the setting sun.

famous: 秋氣堪悲未必然，輕寒政是可人天。
titleEn: An Evening Stroll in the Autumn Cool

appreciation.zh-CN: 一反悲秋，说微寒正是宜人天气，又见小荷叶如铜钱，清新可喜。
appreciation.en: Who says autumn must be sad? A light chill makes the most pleasant weather. The red lotus blossoms are gone, yet tiny new leaves the size of coins are still opening.

famous: 只言山色秋蕭索，繡出西湖三四峰。

appreciation.zh-CN: 梧叶黄、柿叶红、枫叶丹，秋色把西湖群山绣得五彩斑斓。
appreciation.en: Parasol leaves turn yellow, persimmon leaves red, and tallow trees and maples flame. People call autumn hills bleak, yet the season has embroidered several peaks around West Lake.

famous: 西風儘有東風手，柿葉楓林別樣春。

appreciation.zh-CN: 秋山并不冷落，西风也有春风的妙手，染红柿叶枫林，别是一番春色。
appreciation.en: Do not call the autumn hills dreary; every season is new in its own way. The west wind has the east wind's skill, and persimmon leaves and maple woods make a spring of their own.

famous: 小楓一夜偷天酒，却倩孤松掩醉容。

appreciation.zh-CN: 把乌桕比作染工、小枫比作偷酒醉红了脸，拟人诙谐，秋色活泼。
appreciation.en: The tallow tree, an old dyer, has mistaken black for scarlet. A little maple stole heaven's wine overnight and now hides its flushed face behind a lone pine.

famous: 江上秋風晚來急，爲傳鐘鼓到西興。

appreciation.zh-CN: 青山断处宝塔层层，晚来秋风急，把钟鼓声送到对岸，声景交融。
appreciation.en: Where the green hills break, pagoda tiers rise, and the far shore seems close enough to call to. The autumn wind picks up at evening and carries the temple bells and drums across to Xixing.

famous: 月色如霜不粟肌，月光如水不沾衣。

appreciation.zh-CN: 月色如霜却不冷，月光如水却不湿衣，正是初凉未寒的好时节。
appreciation.en: Moonlight looks like frost but raises no goosebumps; it flows like water but never wets one's clothes. This is the sweet time of early autumn, cool but not yet cold.

famous: 寄語重門休上鑰，夜潮留向月中看。
titleEn: Watching the Tide on the Fifteenth of the Eighth Month

appreciation.zh-CN: 中秋月圆、霜风初起，嘱咐城门别上锁，要在月光下看夜潮，兴致盎然。
appreciation.en: Su Shi knows the moon will be perfectly round, though the wind already feels like the ninth month. He asks the gatekeepers not to lock up, so he can watch the night tide by moonlight.

famous: 水光山色与人亲，说不尽、无穷好。

appreciation.zh-CN: 暮秋湖上，水光山色亲近可人，莲子已成，鸥鹭安眠，清丽明快。
appreciation.en: Late autumn wind ripples the wide lake and the flowers are thinning. Yet the water and hills feel warm and friendly, endlessly lovely, while gulls doze on the sand.

famous: 何须浅碧深红色，自是花中第一流。

appreciation.zh-CN: 桂花淡黄柔美，香气悠远，不靠艳色也是花中第一流，品格高雅。
appreciation.en: The osmanthus is pale yellow and gentle, and only its fragrance lingers. It needs no bright greens or deep reds; it is naturally first among flowers, outshining plum and chrysanthemum.

famous: 揉破黄金万点轻。剪成碧玉叶层层。

appreciation.zh-CN: 桂花如揉碎的黄金，叶似剪成的碧玉，风度清朗，比喻精巧。
appreciation.en: Osmanthus blossoms look like countless flecks of crumpled gold among layered jade-green leaves. Their bearing is bright and refined, making plum and lilac seem common.

famous: 枕上诗书闲处好，门前风景雨来佳。
titleEn: Sand of Washing Stream: Rising from Illness

appreciation.zh-CN: 病后闲卧，枕边读书，门前雨景正好，桂花终日相伴，恬淡安然。
appreciation.en: Recovering from illness, the poet watches the waning moon at her window and sips cardamom water. Reading in bed is a fine way to idle, the view outside is lovely in rain, and the osmanthus keeps her gentle company.

famous: 不如随分尊前醉，莫负东篱菊蕊黄。
titleEn: Partridge Sky: Cold Sun at the Window

appreciation.zh-CN: 深秋寒日，饮罢品茶、梦醒焚香，与其感怀不如尽兴一醉，莫负黄菊。
appreciation.en: Late autumn sun falls on the lattice and frost has touched the parasol trees. Bitter tea after wine, incense after dreams: better to drink contentedly than brood, and not waste the yellow chrysanthemums.

famous: 欲说还休。却道天凉好个秋。
titleEn: Ugly Slave: Written on a Wall on the Boshan Road

appreciation.zh-CN: 少年强说愁，中年识尽愁却只道天凉好个秋，举重若轻，耐人回味。
appreciation.en: As a youth he climbed towers and forced himself to write about sorrow. Now that he truly knows it, he starts to speak and stops, and says only: what a fine, cool autumn.

famous: 西风梨枣山园。儿童偷把长竿。
titleEn: Clear Peaceful Joy: Inspecting the Orchard

appreciation.zh-CN: 松竹连云、新酒初熟，孩子偷打梨枣，老人静看不惊，乡居乐趣十足。
appreciation.en: Pines and bamboo reach the clouds and the home-brewed wine is ready. When the west wind ripens pears and dates, children sneak in with long poles, and the old man quietly watches without scaring them.

famous: 月明秋晓。翠盖团团好。

appreciation.zh-CN: 秋晓月明，桂花小如碎金藏在叶中，只折两三枝便满室生香，清新可爱。
appreciation.en: On a moonlit autumn dawn the osmanthus tree spreads its round green canopy. Its blossoms are tiny as snipped gold hidden among leaves, and just two or three sprigs fill a room with scent.

famous: 远村秋色如画，红树间疏黄。

appreciation.zh-CN: 芙蓉金菊斗香，将近重阳，远村秋色如画，红树黄叶相间，明丽开阔。
appreciation.en: Hibiscus and golden chrysanthemums compete in fragrance as the Double Ninth nears. The distant village is painted with autumn, red trees mixed with yellow, under a long blue sky.

famous: 金菊满丛珠颗细，海燕辞巢翅羽轻。
titleEn: Breaking the Ranks: West Wind on the Lake

appreciation.zh-CN: 西风斜日，荷花落尽，金菊满丛，新酒高歌，劝人珍惜美好时光。
appreciation.en: West wind and slanting sun on the lake; the lotus has finished blooming. Chrysanthemums are heavy with tiny buds and swallows leave their nests, so pour the new wine and sing while time flows on.

famous: 黄菊枝头生晓寒。人生莫放酒杯乾。

appreciation.zh-CN: 晓寒中黄菊盛开，簪花醉舞，身健加餐，以旷达之态笑对人生。
appreciation.en: Morning chill rises on the yellow chrysanthemums; never let your wine cup run dry. Playing the flute in the wind, wearing flowers askew while drunk, the poet says: stay healthy, eat well, and enjoy.

famous: 莫笑老翁犹气岸。君看。几人黄菊上华颠。
titleEn: Calming the Waves: Double Ninth in Qianzhong

appreciation.zh-CN: 贬地久雨，重阳忽晴，老翁簪菊驰射，豪气不减，豁达乐观。
appreciation.en: In rainy Qianzhong, where living feels like being on a boat, the Double Ninth dawns clear. Don't laugh at the old man's high spirits: how many white heads still wear yellow chrysanthemums so proudly?

famous: 弄涛儿向涛头立。手把红旗旗不湿。

appreciation.zh-CN: 回忆钱塘观潮，万人争看，潮声如万鼓齐鸣，弄潮儿立于浪头，惊险壮观。
appreciation.en: The poet remembers the whole city crowding the bank to watch the Qiantang tide, which came as if the sea had emptied, roaring like ten thousand drums. Tide riders stood on the crest holding red flags that never got wet.

famous: 三三两两钓鱼舟。岛屿正清秋。

appreciation.zh-CN: 凭栏望西湖，钓舟三两、岛屿清秋，笛声起于芦花，白鸟成行，清远如画。
appreciation.en: The poet recalls leaning on a railing all day above West Lake. Fishing boats drift in twos and threes, the islands lie in clear autumn, a flute sounds among the reeds and white birds rise in a line.

famous: 菊暗荷枯一夜霜。新苞绿叶照林光。

appreciation.zh-CN: 一夜霜后菊暗荷枯，橘子却青黄满林，香雾喷人，清泉般沁齿，生机盎然。
appreciation.en: After a night of frost the chrysanthemums dim and the lotus withers, yet new fruit shines among green leaves. Peeled, the oranges spray fragrant mist and taste like cool spring water.

famous: 不用悲秋，今年身健还高宴。

appreciation.zh-CN: 开篇便说不用悲秋，身体康健还能登高设宴，乐观豁达。
appreciation.en: No need to grieve over autumn: this year he is healthy and can still hold a fine feast. Orchids and chrysanthemums mingle while white clouds fly and the geese return as they do every year.

famous: 醉中吹堕白纶巾，溪风漾流月。
titleEn: Happy Event Approaching: On the Lake

appreciation.zh-CN: 雨后秋湖，醉中头巾被风吹落，溪风摇荡月影，独棹小舟随波，洒脱自在。
appreciation.en: After rain the autumn lake has risen half a pole deep. Drunk, the poet's white scarf blows off, the stream breeze sets the moon's reflection rippling, and he rows home alone, drifting on the misty waves.

famous: 多少六朝兴废事，尽入渔樵闲话。

appreciation.zh-CN: 江山如画，秋色潇洒，竹篱茅舍、客帆酒旗，六朝兴亡都成了渔樵闲话。
appreciation.en: The river and hills look like a painting, and the autumn scenery is fresh and free. Reeds, bamboo fences, sails and wine flags fill the view, and all the rise and fall of the Six Dynasties is now just idle talk among fishermen and woodcutters.

famous: 病夫因病得来游。更值满川微雨、洗新秋。

appreciation.zh-CN: 借病假泛舟秋塘，微雨洗新秋，一路繁花相送，轻快喜悦。
appreciation.en: For three days the poet's boat glides along autumn ponds past lotus flowers. Sick leave lets him travel, and a fine rain washes the new autumn while blossoms see him all the way.

famous: 红蓼一湾纹缬乱，白鱼双尾玉刀明。

appreciation.zh-CN: 行到洞庭，楚天开阔，红蓼映水、白鱼如玉，夜凉星影浸船，明丽清凉。
appreciation.en: Arriving at Dongting, the poet sees green peaks under a wide southern sky and still evening water. Red knotweed ripples in a bay, white fish flash like jade knives, and starlight soaks the boat in the cool night.

famous: 满载一船秋色，平铺十里湖光。
titleEn: West River Moon: Held by the Wind

appreciation.zh-CN: 被风阻于湖上，却说满载一船秋色，看斜阳、宿湖边也无妨，乐观洒脱。
appreciation.en: Stopped by the wind, the boat is loaded with autumn colors over ten li of shining lake. The river god simply wants him to watch the sunset; tomorrow's wind will be better, and a night under the dew is no hardship.

famous: 秋晓上莲峰，高蹑倚天青壁。

appreciation.zh-CN: 秋晨策杖登莲花峰，忽见雷雨四起，想象谈笑间带来丰年，豪迈奇逸。
appreciation.en: On an autumn dawn the poet climbs Lotus Peak up sky-high cliffs, his staff his only companion. The staff seems to turn into a red dragon and thunderstorms darken the hills, bringing rain for a good harvest.

famous: 遙望洞庭山水翠，白銀盤裏一青螺。

appreciation.zh-CN: 秋月湖光交融，湖面如镜，君山如白银盘中一颗青螺，比喻新奇。
appreciation.en: Lake light and autumn moon blend in harmony, and the windless water is like an unpolished mirror. From afar, Junshan looks like a green snail shell on a silver plate.

famous: 今夜月明人盡望，不知秋思在誰家。
titleEn: Gazing at the Moon on the Fifteenth Night

appreciation.zh-CN: 中秋夜庭院月白、桂花沾露，人人望月，秋思悠悠，清冷而美。
appreciation.en: On mid-autumn night the courtyard is white with moonlight, crows roost and cold dew wets the osmanthus. Everyone is looking at the bright moon tonight; whose house holds the deepest autumn longing?

famous: 峨眉山月半輪秋，影入平羌江水流。
titleEn: Song of the Emei Mountain Moon

appreciation.zh-CN: 半轮秋月挂在峨眉山上，月影随江水流动，夜发清溪，意境清远。
appreciation.en: A half moon of autumn hangs over Mount Emei and its reflection flows with the Pingqiang River. Setting off at night, the young poet sails toward the Three Gorges.

famous: 舉頭望明月，低頭思故鄉。

appreciation.zh-CN: 床前月光如霜，抬头望月、低头思乡，语言浅白，情味悠长。
appreciation.en: Moonlight before the bed looks like frost on the ground. Raising his head he gazes at the bright moon; lowering it, he thinks of home.

famous: 登舟望秋月，空憶謝將軍。

appreciation.zh-CN: 江夜无云，登舟望秋月，怀想古人知音，明朝枫叶纷纷，清旷洒脱。
appreciation.en: On a cloudless night on the West River, Li Bai looks at the autumn moon from his boat and recalls an ancient general who prized a poet's chanting. Tomorrow he will hoist sail as maple leaves fall.

famous: 且就洞庭賒月色，將船買酒白雲邊。

appreciation.zh-CN: 秋夜湖面无烟，想乘流上天，向洞庭赊月色、到白云边买酒，浪漫奇想。
appreciation.en: On a mist-free autumn night the lake seems to flow straight up to heaven. Let us buy moonlight from Dongting on credit and row our boat to the edge of the white clouds for wine.

famous: 淥水淨素月，月明白鷺飛。

appreciation.zh-CN: 清水映素月，月下白鹭飞，采菱女夜歌而归，清新明净。
appreciation.en: Clear water holds the pale moon and egrets fly in the moonlight. Girls gathering water chestnuts sing all the way home through the night.

famous: 青女素娥俱耐冷，月中霜裏鬬嬋娟。

appreciation.zh-CN: 雁来蝉尽，高楼临水，霜神与月神在清寒中比美，想象瑰丽。
appreciation.en: Geese have come and cicadas fallen silent; the tall tower overlooks water merging with sky. The goddess of frost and the goddess of the moon, both unbothered by cold, vie in beauty in the moonlit frost.

famous: 二十四橋明月夜，玉人何處教吹簫。

appreciation.zh-CN: 江南秋尽，青山隐隐，二十四桥明月下箫声悠扬，风致动人。
appreciation.en: Blue hills fade into the distance, waters stretch far, and late autumn in the south has not yet stripped the grass. On a moonlit night at Twenty-Four Bridges, where is a friend teaching someone to play the flute?

famous: 至今不會天中事，應是嫦娥擲與人。
titleEn: Osmanthus Seeds at Tianzhu Temple on Mid-Autumn Night

appreciation.zh-CN: 中秋夜桂子如玉粒从月中落下，诗人猜是嫦娥抛给人间的，想象浪漫。
appreciation.en: On mid-autumn night pearly osmanthus seeds seem to fall from the moon, fresh with dew in front of the temple hall. The poet guesses Chang'e must have tossed them down to people below.

famous: 乘风好去，长空万里，直下看山河。

appreciation.zh-CN: 中秋把酒问月，想乘风上天，砍去桂树让清光更多，气魄雄奇。
appreciation.en: The autumn moon rolls out golden waves like a freshly polished flying mirror. Raising his cup to Chang'e, the poet wishes to ride the wind into the sky, look down on the land, and cut away the osmanthus so the moon shines even brighter.

famous: 暮雲收盡溢清寒，銀漢無聲轉玉盤。

appreciation.zh-CN: 暮云散尽，清寒满溢，明月如玉盘在银河中无声转动，劝人珍惜良宵。
appreciation.en: Evening clouds clear away and a pure chill fills the air. The moon turns silently like a jade plate across the Milky Way, a reminder to treasure this lovely night.

famous: 如今才是十三夜，月色已如玉。
titleEn: Happy Event Approaching: Moon over Chengzhai

appreciation.zh-CN: 月光先照花园，隔竹才到书斋；十三夜月已如玉，十五十六更奇绝。
appreciation.en: The moon reaches the flower garden before the poet's study, hidden behind a grove of bamboo. Tonight is only the thirteenth and the moonlight is already like jade; wait for the fifteenth and sixteenth.

famous: 身外水天銀一色，城中有此月明無。

appreciation.zh-CN: 中秋泛舟太湖，水天一片银白，城里哪有这样的明月，悠然自得。
appreciation.en: Mid-autumn belongs to the recluse, who rows out onto the shining expanse of Lake Tai. Water and sky are one silver color around him; is there a moon this bright in the city?

famous: 夜深知雪重，時聞折竹聲。

appreciation.zh-CN: 不写雪的样子，只写衾冷、窗明与折竹之声，从侧面写出夜雪之大，别致传神。
appreciation.en: The poet feels his quilt grow cold and sees the window turn bright. Late at night he knows the snow is heavy, for now and then he hears bamboo snapping under its weight.

famous: 不知近水花先發，疑是經春雪未銷。

appreciation.zh-CN: 溪桥边一树白梅如玉，诗人疑是残雪未消，以雪喻梅，写尽早梅的洁白与早发。
appreciation.en: A plum tree with branches like white jade stands by a village bridge. Not knowing that trees near water bloom first, the poet mistakes its flowers for snow that has not yet melted.

famous: 來日綺窗前，寒梅着花未。

appreciation.zh-CN: 见到故乡来人，不问别事，只问窗前寒梅开了没有，乡情含蓄而雅致。
appreciation.en: Meeting someone from his hometown, the poet asks just one thing: has the winter plum by the carved window started to bloom? A whole homeland is held in that small question.

famous: 忽見寒梅樹，開花漢水濱。

appreciation.zh-CN: 汉水边忽见寒梅盛开，诗人疑是江妃弄珠，惊喜之情跃然纸上。
appreciation.en: By the Han River the poet suddenly comes upon a winter plum in bloom. Unaware that spring has come early, he half believes he has met the river nymph playing with her pearls.

famous: 地白風色寒，雪花大如手。
titleEn: Teasing Wang of Liyang for Refusing to Drink

appreciation.zh-CN: 雪花大如手的寒日，李白笑友人空学陶潜却不肯饮酒，诙谐豪放，满纸酒兴。
appreciation.en: The ground is white and snowflakes fall as big as hands. Li Bai playfully mocks a friend who imitates Tao Yuanming yet will not drink, a poem full of humor and high spirits.

famous: 十月江南天氣好，可憐冬景似春華。

appreciation.zh-CN: 十月江南草未衰、日暖沙干，诗人发现初冬竟如春日般明媚可爱。
appreciation.en: In the tenth month the weather south of the Yangtze is fine, and the early winter scenery looks like spring. The grass is still green, the sand dries in warm sun, and the poet longs for an idle drink.

famous: 隔牖風驚竹，開門雪滿山。
titleEn: Thinking of Layman Hu on a Snowy Winter Evening

appreciation.zh-CN: 风惊竹响，开门见雪满山，深巷寂静、庭院空明，清幽雪景中透出隐逸之思。
appreciation.en: Wind startles the bamboo outside the window, and opening the door the poet finds the mountains full of snow. Lanes are hushed and courtyards lie white and still, calling to mind a friend living in quiet retreat.

famous: 江上晚來堪畫處，漁人披得一蓑歸。

appreciation.zh-CN: 雪花打湿僧舍茶烟、冲淡歌楼酒力，江上渔人披蓑归来，宛然一幅水墨雪景。
appreciation.en: Snow dampens the tea smoke of a monastery and the warmth of wine in a singing hall. At dusk on the river a fisherman returns wrapped in a snow-covered straw cape, a scene worth painting.

famous: 六出飛花入戶時，坐看青竹變瓊枝。

appreciation.zh-CN: 六角雪花飘入门户，青竹转眼化作玉枝，登楼远望，白雪覆盖了人间崎岖。
appreciation.en: Six-pointed flakes drift in through the door, and green bamboo turns to branches of jade. Now is the time to climb a tall tower, for the snow has covered every rough road in the world.

famous: 天人寧許巧，翦水作花飛。

appreciation.zh-CN: 北风骤急，庭前如月光般明亮，原来是天人巧手剪水成花，想象新奇灵动。
appreciation.en: The north wind blows hard and the front courtyard shines as if under moonlight. How clever the heavens are, cutting water into flowers and setting them flying.

famous: 簷前數片無人埽，又得書窗一夜明。

appreciation.zh-CN: 风卷寒云，暮雪初晴，檐前残雪无人扫，正好映得书窗一夜明亮，清雅可爱。
appreciation.en: Wind rolls away the cold clouds and the evening snow clears. A few patches by the eaves go unswept, and they keep the study window bright all night.

famous: 輕盈照溪水，掩斂下瑤臺。

appreciation.zh-CN: 梅花轻盈地映照溪水，如仙子降临瑶台，与雪争白，先春而开，清丽脱俗。
appreciation.en: Light and graceful, the plum blossoms are mirrored in the stream like fairies come down from a jade terrace. They rival the snow in whiteness and seem to open just for a cup of winter wine.

famous: 火是臘天春，雪爲陰夜月。

appreciation.zh-CN: 炉火是腊月里的春天，白雪是阴夜里的月光，围炉赏雪、饮酒听歌，乐而忘时。
appreciation.en: The poet loves both fire and snow: fire is spring in the twelfth month, snow is moonlight on a dark night. By a glowing brazier, with wine and music, he watches goose-down flakes fall and forgets the hour.

famous: 漫漫一川橫渭水，太陽初出五陵高。

appreciation.zh-CN: 乐游原上大雪如鹅毛，渭水横陈，旭日初升，五陵高处一片晶莹，气象开阔。
appreciation.en: From the Leyou plateau the poet watches snow like goose feathers. Palaces look like stars and trees like fine brush tips; the Wei River stretches wide as the sun rises over the snowy imperial tombs.

famous: 落照入寒光，偏能伴幽寂。

appreciation.zh-CN: 晴野之雪已消，唯有深松下积雪犹存，映着落照寒光，静静陪伴幽居之人。
appreciation.en: Elsewhere the snow has melted in the sun, but beneath the deep pines it lingers. Catching the cold light of sunset, it keeps quiet company with the solitude of the place.

famous: 草堂雪夜攜琴宿，說是青城館裏時。
titleEn: A Snowy Night Shared with Xiao Yuan

appreciation.zh-CN: 雪夜草堂，兄弟携琴同宿，谈起蜀中旧游，亲情与诗情交融，温暖自在。
appreciation.en: On a snowy night the poet and his kinsman share a thatched hut, a zither and new poems. They talk of their days together at the Qingcheng lodge in Shu.

famous: 夜歸不到應閑事，熱飲三杯即是家。
titleEn: Returning Late on the Pingquan Road on a Winter Day

appreciation.zh-CN: 山路难行、日短天寒，诗人却从容自得：晚归又何妨，热酒三杯便是家。
appreciation.en: The mountain road is hard and the winter sun sets early over frosty trees and roosting crows. Getting home late hardly matters, says the poet: three cups of warm wine and he is already at home.

famous: 夜寒生酒思，曉雪引詩情。
titleEn: On a Snowy Morning, Setting Out to Visit Minister Li

appreciation.zh-CN: 夜寒引出酒兴，晓雪勾起诗情，热饮冷吟，披氅出门访友，雅兴十足。
appreciation.en: The cold night stirs a craving for wine, and morning snow stirs a mood for poetry. After a cup or two of warm wine the poet throws on a crane-feather cloak and sets out to visit a friend.

famous: 飛鴉疑翅重，去馬覺蹄輕。

appreciation.zh-CN: 细雪无声，渐与阶平，飞鸦似翅膀变重，马蹄踏雪轻软，观察细腻入微。
appreciation.en: Fine snow settles on grass and trees until it is level with the steps, falling without a sound. Crows seem to fly with heavier wings, and horses step lightly over the soft white ground.

famous: 樵人歸白屋，寒日下危峯。

appreciation.zh-CN: 倚杖望晴雪，樵夫归家、寒日落峰，暮钟声里，雪后山村清冷而安宁。
appreciation.en: Leaning on his staff, the poet gazes at the snow after it clears. Woodcutters return to white cottages, the cold sun sinks behind the peaks, and the evening bell of a mountain temple sounds.

famous: 瑞雪初盈尺，寒宵始半更。
titleEn: A Winter Night Banquet at Magistrate Zhang's

appreciation.zh-CN: 瑞雪盈尺的寒夜，炉炭正暖，宾主刻烛赋诗、听琴饮酒，不觉已到鸡鸣。
appreciation.en: Auspicious snow lies a foot deep on a cold night. Friends gather by a warm brazier, compose poems against a burning candle and listen to music until the rooster crows at dawn.

famous: 園中有早梅，年例犯寒開。

appreciation.zh-CN: 园中早梅每年冒寒先开，女子折来插在镜台前，看不够还想剪下，生活情趣盎然。
appreciation.en: Every year the early plum in the garden braves the cold to bloom. A young woman breaks off a sprig for her mirror stand, and still not satisfied, wishes she could cut out more.

famous: 雪花酒上滅，頓覺夜寒無。
titleEn: Drinking on a Snowy Night by the Clear Stream

appreciation.zh-CN: 雪花落入酒杯即化，夜寒顿消，清风动竹、越鸟相呼，诗人自得其乐。
appreciation.en: Wrapped in a fur cloak beside a white jade wine jar, the poet watches snowflakes vanish on his wine, and the night chill is gone. A guest sings mountain songs and the wind stirs the bamboo; this is joy enough.

famous: 共愛朝來何處雪，蓬萊宮裏拂松枝。
titleEn: Leaving Court After a Snowy Night

appreciation.zh-CN: 清晨散朝，青山满目，同僚们共赏宫中松枝上的新雪，清雅从容。
appreciation.en: Coming out from the dawn audience, the poet sees blue hills beyond the palace walls. Everyone admires the morning snow, especially where it brushes the pine branches in the palace.

famous: 竹外山低塔，藤間院隔橋。
titleEn: Visiting Ci'en Temple with Friends After Snow

appreciation.zh-CN: 雪后乘兴访寺，竹外塔影、藤间小桥，清幽景色让人尘虑全消。
appreciation.en: On a whim the poet and friends visit a temple after snow. Snow melts from the twin trees, a pagoda rises beyond the bamboo, and a bridge appears among the vines; worldly cares fade away.

famous: 數處微明銷不盡，湖山清映越人家。
titleEn: Snow Clearing, Seen from the Kuaiji Tower

appreciation.zh-CN: 昨夜雪如花，登楼望去残雪微明，湖光山色清清映照着越地人家，明净秀美。
appreciation.en: Snow fell like flowers last night over the river city. From the tower, patches of lingering snow still gleam, and lakes and hills shine clear above the homes of Yue.

famous: 侵陵雪色還萱草，漏洩春光有柳條。

appreciation.zh-CN: 今年腊日冰雪消融，萱草返青、柳条透出春光，一派暖意与喜气。
appreciation.en: This year on the La Day the ice has already melted. The daylilies show green again through the snow and the willow twigs leak hints of spring.

famous: 羣木方憎雪，開花長在先。

appreciation.zh-CN: 群木畏雪之时，梅花偏偏抢先开放，不与莺蝶结缘，孤高自守。
appreciation.en: While other trees hate the snow, the plum always blooms first. It never waits for orioles and butterflies, keeping its own lofty company.

famous: 寒窗呵筆尋詩句，一片飛來紙上銷。

appreciation.zh-CN: 雪中扫松叶煮茶、挖冻菜，寒窗下呵笔寻诗，一片雪花飞落纸上即化，情趣盎然。
appreciation.en: Snow falls generously on a humble lane. The poet digs frozen greens and burns pine needles; by the cold window he breathes on his brush to write, and a flake drifts onto the paper and melts.

famous: 三日柴門擁不開，階平庭滿白皚皚。
titleEn: Replying to Secretary Wang's Poem Sent in the Snow

appreciation.zh-CN: 大雪三日封门，庭阶一片皑皑，诗人踏雪而出，只因友人寄诗而来，欣喜可感。
appreciation.en: For three days snow has blocked the brushwood gate, filling the courtyard white and level with the steps. Today the poet tramps out a jade-like path, because a poem has arrived from a friend.

famous: 紅蠟燭前明似晝，青氈帳裏暖如春。
titleEn: Delighted by Li's Visit on a Snowy Night

appreciation.zh-CN: 鹅毛雪夜友人来访，红烛如昼、毡帐如春，满斟美酒留客共宿，诗情酒意相亲。
appreciation.en: On a night of goose-feather snow a friend in a crane-down cloak comes to call. Red candles make the room bright as day and the felt tent is warm as spring; full cups and good poems keep him overnight.

famous: 欲尋聯句卷，先飲煖寒杯。

appreciation.zh-CN: 冷竹成韵、落叶成堆，初冬里开炉试火、温酒联句，闲适中带着对友人的想念。
appreciation.en: Wind sings in the cold bamboo and leaves pile in the empty street. Before looking out his verse-capping scrolls, the poet drinks a cup to ward off the cold and lights the stove for the first time this winter.

famous: 融雪煎香茗，調酥煮乳糜。

appreciation.zh-CN: 冬日晚起，暖炉生火，融雪煎茶、调酥煮粥，慵懒自嘲中满是快活。
appreciation.en: After a long lazy sleep the poet rises late. The stove is lit, snow is melted to brew fragrant tea and milk porridge simmers; he laughs at his own idleness, content and happy.

famous: 年年任霜霰，不減篔簹綠。

appreciation.zh-CN: 冷日寒风之中，竹子年年任凭霜雪侵袭，依旧青翠不减，坚贞可敬。
appreciation.en: The southern sun runs cold and the north wind howls through empty trees. Yet year after year, whatever frost and sleet may come, the tall bamboo loses none of its green.

famous: 梅花不肯傍春光，自向深冬著豔陽。

appreciation.zh-CN: 梅花不肯依傍春光，偏在深冬绽放，风雪越大香气越浓，品格清高。
appreciation.en: The plum refuses to lean on spring, choosing to blaze in deep winter instead. Fierce wind only deepens its charm and snow only adds to its fragrance.

famous: 遥知不是雪，爲有暗香來。

appreciation.zh-CN: 墙角几枝梅凌寒独放，远看似雪，一缕暗香道破真相，简淡中见高洁。
appreciation.en: A few sprigs of plum by the corner of a wall bloom alone in the cold. From afar they look like snow, but a faint fragrance drifting over tells you otherwise.

famous: 疏影橫斜水清淺，暗香浮動月黄昏。
titleEn: Little Plum Tree in a Mountain Garden

appreciation.zh-CN: 百花凋零时梅花独自鲜妍，疏影映在清浅水中，暗香浮动于月下黄昏，千古咏梅绝唱。
appreciation.en: When all other flowers have faded, the plum alone is bright in the little garden. Its sparse shadows slant over clear shallow water, and its hidden fragrance drifts in the moonlit dusk.

famous: 梅須遜雪三分白，雪却輸梅一段香。

appreciation.zh-CN: 梅与雪争春各有所长：梅不如雪白，雪不及梅香，评得巧妙风趣。
appreciation.en: Plum and snow argue over who brings spring, leaving the poet unable to judge. The plum must yield to the snow in whiteness, but the snow loses to the plum in fragrance.

famous: 霜風掃盡千林葉，閒倚筇枝數鸛巢。

appreciation.zh-CN: 斜日低山、片月初升，霜风扫尽林叶，诗人倚杖闲数鹳巢，冬日田园闲适宁静。
appreciation.en: The slanting sun sinks behind low hills as a sliver of moon rises. Frosty wind has stripped the woods bare, and the poet leans on his bamboo staff counting stork nests in the trees.

famous: 從教屋外陰風吼，卧聽籬頭響玉簫。

appreciation.zh-CN: 屋顶添茅、泥墙密实，任凭屋外寒风怒吼，躺着听来也如玉箫，农家冬日自在安稳。
appreciation.en: An extra bundle of thatch on the roof and freshly plastered walls make the farmhouse snug as a monk's cell. Let the cold wind roar outside; lying in bed, it sounds like a jade flute by the fence.

famous: 不受塵埃半點侵，竹籬茅舍自甘心。

appreciation.zh-CN: 梅花不染半点尘埃，甘守竹篱茅舍，只因结识林逋，从此被诗人传颂至今。
appreciation.en: The plum lets not a speck of dust touch it and is content beside bamboo fences and thatched huts. Only because it once befriended the recluse Lin Bu have poets praised it ever since.

famous: 五更曉色來書幌，半夜寒聲落畫檐。
titleEn: Written on the Wall of the North Terrace After Snow

appreciation.zh-CN: 黄昏细雨、夜静转寒，五更时书帷透亮才知大雪满院，远山双峰犹露雪中，写雪传神。
appreciation.en: A drizzle at dusk turns to snow in the still night. The poet only feels his quilt grow cold, but at the fifth watch dawn light fills the study curtain and the courtyard is heaped with white.

famous: 滿庭更遣遲銷著，剩借書窗幾夜明。

appreciation.zh-CN: 顷刻间银屋玉阶，雪花无声飘洒，诗人盼它晚些消融，好多映亮书窗几夜。
appreciation.en: In a moment the houses turn silver and the steps to jade, as snow falls without a sound. The poet hopes it lingers in the courtyard so his study window stays bright a few more nights.

famous: 仙人翦水作花飛，忽化瓊瑶已大奇。

appreciation.zh-CN: 仙人剪水成花，化作琼瑶，雪晴后又化回清水，满地如琉璃，想象奇妙轻快。
appreciation.en: Immortals cut water into flowers and send them flying, and they become jade, which is marvel enough. Then the jade turns back into water and the ground glitters like glass.

famous: 幽香淡淡影疏疏，雪虐風饕亦自如。
titleEn: Seeking Plum Blossoms in the Snow

appreciation.zh-CN: 梅花香淡影疏，任凭风雪肆虐依然从容自在，如隐士般不慕人间富贵。
appreciation.en: The fragrance is faint and the shadows sparse, yet the plum stays calm amid raging wind and snow. Like the ancient hermits, it cares nothing for worldly riches.

famous: 溪柴火輭蠻氊暖，我與狸奴不出門。
titleEn: A Great Storm on the Fourth Day of the Eleventh Month

appreciation.zh-CN: 风雨大作、四山如海涛翻涌，屋内柴火正软、毛毡正暖，诗人与猫儿安然不出门。
appreciation.en: Wind sweeps the rivers and rain darkens the village, the hills roaring like ocean waves. Inside, the brushwood fire is soft and the felt rug warm; the poet and his cat stay in.

famous: 敲成玉磬穿林響，忽作玻瓈碎地聲。

appreciation.zh-CN: 孩童清晨从金盆脱下冰块，穿上彩线当锣敲，玉磬声后忽然碎落，童趣盎然。
appreciation.en: Early in the morning a child lifts a disc of ice from a brass basin and threads it on a colored string as a gong. It rings like a jade chime through the woods, then suddenly shatters like glass on the ground.

famous: 何方可化身千億，一樹梅前一放翁。

appreciation.zh-CN: 听说梅花在晓风中绽放，雪堆满山，诗人奇想化身千亿，每树梅前都站一个自己。
appreciation.en: The poet hears the plums have burst open in the dawn wind, snow heaped across the hills. If only he could split into a billion selves, so that one Lu You might stand before every tree.

famous: 何人更似蘇夫子，不是花時肯獨來。
titleEn: Visiting Jixiang Temple Alone on the Winter Solstice

appreciation.zh-CN: 冬至寒雨中独游花寺，不为看花，只为一份闲情，诗人自嘲中透出洒脱。
appreciation.en: On the winter solstice the warmth of the sun has barely begun to return, and cold rain soaks the withered roots. Who else, the poet jokes, would come alone to a flower temple when nothing is in bloom?

famous: 有梅無雪不精神，有雪無詩俗了人。

appreciation.zh-CN: 梅、雪、诗三者缺一不可，暮色中诗成雪又落，与梅合成十分春色，风雅有趣。
appreciation.en: Plum without snow lacks spirit, and snow without a poem is merely ordinary. Just as the poem is finished at dusk, snow begins to fall again, and with the plum it makes spring complete.

famous: 废圃寒蔬挑翠羽，小槽春酒冻真珠。

appreciation.zh-CN: 雪后醉眠晚起，友人载酒来访，园中挑寒蔬、槽中酒如冻珠，细嚼梅须，清香有味。
appreciation.en: Still drowsy from wine, the poet hears a friend's carriage at the gate. They pick winter greens like kingfisher feathers from the old garden, sip wine frozen like pearls and nibble plum stamens.

famous: 半山槲葉當窗下，一夜曾聞雪打聲。

appreciation.zh-CN: 王屋山中石龛松寺，半山槲叶落在窗前，一夜听得雪打之声，清幽宁静。
appreciation.en: From the south cliff of Mount Wangwu one can see Luoyang, and a pine temple sits high above. Oak leaves on the mountainside hang by the window, and all night long the poet hears snow tapping on them.

famous: 半空舞倦居然嬾，一點風來特地忙。

appreciation.zh-CN: 雪花半空舞倦便慵懒飘落，一阵风来又忽然忙乱，诗人写雪如写人，活泼风趣。
appreciation.en: By dusk the snow is a foot deep and glowing with cold light. Tired of dancing in midair the flakes drift lazily, but the moment a breeze comes they hurry about again.

famous: 晚來拭浄南窗紙，便覺斜陽一倍紅。

appreciation.zh-CN: 农家点松节当烛，烟熏窗暗，傍晚擦净南窗纸，顿觉斜阳加倍红亮，平常中见喜悦。
appreciation.en: Farmers burn resinous pine knots as candles and the smoke darkens the room like ink. In the evening they wipe the south window paper clean, and the setting sun suddenly looks twice as red.

famous: 紙上得來終覺淺，絕知此事要躬行。
titleEn: Reading on a Winter Night, for My Son Ziyu

appreciation.zh-CN: 冬夜读书时叮嘱儿子：书本得来的学问终究浅，真要明白必须亲身实践。
appreciation.en: On a winter night of reading, the poet tells his son that the ancients spared no effort in learning. Knowledge from paper always stays shallow; to truly understand, you must practice it yourself.

famous: 雨脚半收檐断线，雪林初下瓦疏珠。

appreciation.zh-CN: 雨脚渐收、檐水断线，雪粒初落、瓦上疏珠，临皋雪景细致清新，世间难寻。
appreciation.en: Green winter wheat has not yet stirred and clouds follow the carriage. As the rain thins the eaves stop dripping, and the first snow scatters like pearls across the roof tiles.

famous: 万顷风涛不记苏。雪晴江上麦千车。

appreciation.zh-CN: 雪后江上晴好，诗人想到瑞雪兆丰年，麦收千车，百姓温饱，自己便无忧了。
appreciation.en: Snow has cleared over the river and the poet foresees a thousand cartloads of wheat. As long as the people are fed, he says, he has nothing to worry about.

famous: 偶作小红桃杏色，闲雅，尚馀孤瘦雪霜姿。

appreciation.zh-CN: 红梅偶然染上桃杏之色，骨子里仍是傲雪凌霜的清瘦风姿，借花写人，格调高雅。
appreciation.en: The red plum blooms late and seems out of season. Though it borrows a blush like peach or apricot, it still keeps the lean, frost-defying grace of a true plum.

famous: 忽见客来花下坐，惊飞。蹋散芳英落酒卮。

appreciation.zh-CN: 寒雀争抱梅枝，见客来花下便惊飞，踏落花瓣跌进酒杯，画面灵动有趣。
appreciation.en: Winter sparrows crowd the plum branches to admire the blossoms. When a guest sits down beneath them they take off in alarm, scattering petals into his cup of wine.

famous: 风力无端。欲学杨花更耐寒。

appreciation.zh-CN: 破晓雪花纷飞似织，像杨花却更耐寒，诗人不惹闲愁，折梅上楼，兴致盎然。
appreciation.en: At dawn the snow flies thick as woven silk. It tries to imitate willow catkins but is far hardier in the cold; the poet sets aside idle sorrow and climbs the tower with a sprig of plum.

famous: 更无花态度，全有雪精神。
titleEn: Immortal by the River: Seeking Plum

appreciation.zh-CN: 老来懒于赏花，唯爱绕村寻梅；梅花无俗艳之态，全是雪的清朗精神。
appreciation.en: Grown too old to care for flowers, the poet still circles the village looking for plum. The plum has none of a flower's coquetry, only the spirit of snow; he walks home drunk at moonlit dusk.

famous: 路绕清溪三百曲。香满黄昏雪屋。

appreciation.zh-CN: 断崖修竹间藏着冰玉般的梅，清溪百转，黄昏雪屋里满是梅香，清幽绝俗。
appreciation.en: Among tall bamboo on a steep cliff, plum blossoms hide like ice and jade. The path winds three hundred turns along a clear stream, and at dusk the snowy cottage is filled with their scent.

famous: 百花头上开，冰雪寒中见。

appreciation.zh-CN: 梅花开在百花之先，于冰雪严寒中现身，与霜月相知，最早认识春风的面容。
appreciation.en: The plum blooms ahead of all other flowers and appears amid ice and snow. Frost and moonlight know it well, for it is the first to see the face of the spring wind.

famous: 已惊并水鸥无色，更怪行沙蟹有声。

appreciation.zh-CN: 友人踏雪来访，白雪映得水鸥失色，沙上蟹行有声，豪爽中带着清新之趣。
appreciation.en: A friend arrives to rival the snow in brightness. Gulls by the water vanish against the white, and crabs can be heard scuttling over the sand; the cold air lifts the poet's spirits.

famous: 一笛梅花，吹裂冻云幕。

appreciation.zh-CN: 雪晴风起，松梢积雪如轻鸥片片飞落，一曲梅花笛声仿佛吹裂冻云，意境清峻。
appreciation.en: The snow clears and the wind rises; snow drops from pine tips like small gulls alighting. From a jade tower a flute plays the Plum Blossom tune, as if splitting the frozen curtain of cloud.

famous: 霜馀好探梅消息。日日溪桥侧。

appreciation.zh-CN: 霜后正好探梅，诗人日日守在溪桥边，疏枝冷蕊与老人作伴，淡泊而有情致。
appreciation.en: After the frost it is time to seek news of the plum, and the poet waits by the stream bridge every day. Its sparse, cool blossoms make a quiet neighbor for an old man.

famous: 香非在蕊，香非在萼，骨中香彻。

appreciation.zh-CN: 梅花开如雪、落亦如雪，香气不在花蕊花萼，而是透彻骨中，赞其风骨高洁。
appreciation.en: Plum blossoms look like snow when they open and like snow when they fall. Their fragrance lies not in the stamens or the calyx but deep in their very bones.

famous: 小院一枝梅。冲破晓寒开。

appreciation.zh-CN: 小院一枝梅冲破晓寒开放，诗人赏梅归来满袖生香，举杯尽醉，意犹未尽。
appreciation.en: A single plum branch in the small courtyard breaks through the dawn chill to bloom. Wandering the garden till evening, the poet comes home with sleeves full of fragrance and a cup of wine.

famous: 何人剪碎天边桂。散作瑶田琼蕊。

appreciation.zh-CN: 清晨瑞雪飞遍玉城，仿佛有人剪碎月中桂花撒作琼蕊，想象瑰丽，宴饮尽欢。
appreciation.en: At dawn auspicious snow flies over the jade city. It is as if someone cut up the osmanthus of the moon and scattered it as jade blossoms; the party drinks happily through the long night.

famous: 前村已遍倚南枝。群花犹未知。

appreciation.zh-CN: 雪霜林间隐约见梅，前村南枝已开遍，群花却还不知春近，劝人及时赏芳菲。
appreciation.en: Faint shapes of plum show through the frosty, snowy woods. In the village ahead the southward branches are already in bloom while other flowers know nothing yet, so enjoy them now.

famous: 云高未有前村雪，梅小初开昨夜风。

appreciation.zh-CN: 冬至日箫鼓歌钟一派太平，雪尚未来、梅已初开，屈指春期将近，喜气洋洋。
appreciation.en: On the winter solstice drums and songs celebrate peace as every year. Snow has not yet reached the village but small plum flowers opened in last night's wind; spring is only a few weeks away.

famous: 雪里已知春信至。寒梅点缀琼枝腻。

appreciation.zh-CN: 雪中寒梅点缀玉枝，如新浴美人般清丽，明月相照，金尊共赏，此花不与群花比。
appreciation.en: In the snow one already knows spring is coming, as winter plum dots the jade-white branches. Under bright moonlight friends drink together, for this flower is beyond compare.

famous: 扶杖冻云深处，探溪梅消息。

appreciation.zh-CN: 午后小倦，饮茶驱睡，老人风味不减当年，拄杖走进冻云深处去探溪梅消息。
appreciation.en: Drowsy after lunch, the poet drives off sleep with fine tea. Old but still full of zest, he takes his staff into the frozen clouds to see whether the stream-side plums have bloomed.

famous: 独自风流独自香，明月来寻我。

appreciation.zh-CN: 古涧一枝梅不受园林拘束，不畏山深路远，独自风流独自香，唯有明月来相寻。
appreciation.en: A plum branch by an ancient gully escapes the confines of any garden. Unafraid of the cold in deep mountains, it is graceful and fragrant all on its own, and only the bright moon comes to find it.

famous: 不借芳华只自香，娇面长如洗。

appreciation.zh-CN: 岭上几枝梅疏影临水，不借他物自有清香，花面如洗，比画中更美。
appreciation.en: A few plum branches on the ridge cast sparse shadows over the water. Borrowing no beauty from others, they are fragrant in themselves, their faces always fresh as if just washed.

famous: 折得一枝香在手。人间应未有。

appreciation.zh-CN: 折得一枝梅花，香满手中，疑是人间所无，又似经春残雪，清新可喜。
appreciation.en: Holding a freshly picked sprig of plum, its fragrance fills the hand, surely nothing like it exists on earth. It looks like snow that has lasted into spring.

famous: 半夜萧萧窗外响。多在梅边竹上。

appreciation.zh-CN: 半夜窗外萧萧作响，原是雪落梅边竹上；清晨卷帘，六花片片飞来，轻盈可爱。
appreciation.en: Drifting lightly, the snow puts on all its airs. At midnight it rustles outside the window, mostly on the plum and the bamboo; at dawn the curtain rises and flakes fly in one by one.

famous: 一著画难成，雪霁乱山无数。

appreciation.zh-CN: 一声橹响惊起满川寒鹭，雪霁后群山无数，美得难以入画，令人流连忘返。
appreciation.en: A single creak of an oar startles a whole river of winter egrets. After the snow clears, countless hills appear, a scene too fine to paint, and the poet lingers to count the misty trees.

famous: 小室坐毡重叠，红炉兽炭交加。

appreciation.zh-CN: 小屋里毛毡层层、红炉炭暖，一杯村酒，看窗外密雪飞花，安闲自在。
appreciation.en: In a small room with layers of felt and a red stove full of charcoal, the poet sips village wine. Outside the cold is fierce and thick snow flies like flowers.

famous: 满湖飞雪搅长空。急起呼儿上短蓬。

appreciation.zh-CN: 飞雪漫天搅动长空，渔翁急唤儿子上船，箬笠铁笛，宛如画图，潇洒豪迈。
appreciation.en: Snow fills the sky over the lake. The old fisherman jumps up and calls his son aboard the little boat; in bamboo hats, with an iron flute playing, they look just like a painting.

famous: 春前日绕一千回。花来春未来。

appreciation.zh-CN: 岁寒堂前两株梅商量着先后开，诗人日日绕树千回，花已来春未到，温腊酒共赏。
appreciation.en: Two plum trees before the Hall of Winter Cold seem to discuss which should bloom first. The poet circles them a thousand times a day; the blossoms are here before spring, so he warms the year-end wine.

famous: 煙火漸稀孤店靜，月明深夜古樓中。
titleEn: Viewing the Moon from the Bell Tower After Snow

appreciation.zh-CN: 满山残雪、野寺空寂，人间烟火渐稀，深夜古楼上一轮明月，清寒静谧。
appreciation.en: Lingering snow and wind fill the mountain and the temple courtyards stand empty. As the hearth fires fade and the inn grows still, bright moonlight fills the old tower late at night.

famous: 兩岸嚴風吹玉樹，一灘明月曬銀砂。
titleEn: Boating on South Creek on a Snowy Night

appreciation.zh-CN: 雪夜泛舟，两岸玉树临风，明月照得河滩如晒银砂，寻渔舍、上酒家，兴致悠然。
appreciation.en: On a snowy night the poet rows into a small creek through bamboo and pine. Cold wind sways the jade-white trees and the moon spreads silver over the sandbank; he stops at a tavern and rows on, unhurried.

famous: 溪上寒梅初滿枝，夜來霜月透芳菲。

appreciation.zh-CN: 溪边寒梅初开满枝，夜来霜月清光透过花间，清幽无尽，只待琴酒相伴。
appreciation.en: Winter plum has just covered the branches by the stream. At night the frosty moon shines through the blossoms, a pure light so lovely it calls for music and wine.

famous: 尋常一樣窗前月，纔有梅花便不同。

appreciation.zh-CN: 寒夜以茶代酒待客，竹炉初红，窗前明月寻常，只因多了梅花便别有风致。
appreciation.en: On a cold night a guest arrives and tea takes the place of wine, the water boiling on a bamboo stove. The moon at the window is the same as always, yet with plum blossoms beside it everything feels different.

famous: 游遍瓊樓霜欲曉，却將玉鏡掛青天。
titleEn: Watching Snow on a Moonlit Night

appreciation.zh-CN: 仙人爱雪不怕冷，提着月亮来赏雪，游遍琼楼直到天明，才把玉镜挂回青天，奇想妙趣。
appreciation.en: The immortals love the snow and do not mind the cold, so they carry the moon along to look at it all night. When dawn frost appears, they hang the jade mirror back up in the sky.

famous: 月光雪色兩清寒，見月初疑是雪團。
titleEn: Watching Snow on a Moonlit Night

appreciation.zh-CN: 月光雪色同样清寒，看月疑是雪团，看雪又似月光，原来雪月本是一般模样。
appreciation.en: Moonlight and snow are equally pure and cold. Seeing the moon, the poet first takes it for a snowball; seeing the snow, he thinks it moonlight; in the end, snow and moon are just the same.

famous: 去岁江南见雪时，月底梅花发。

appreciation.zh-CN: 雪、月、梅三者最相宜，去年雪中月下梅开，今年梅月依旧，只欠一场雪。
appreciation.en: Snow and moon go best together, and plum and snow are both pure. Last year plum bloomed under the moon in the snow; this year the plum and moon are here again, only the snow is missing.

famous: 一天云破碎，两树玉扶疏。

appreciation.zh-CN: 与友携酒赏梅，清夜无尘，云破处两树梅如玉扶疏，星稀霜重月华如水，恍如仙境。
appreciation.en: The poet and a friend sit on the grass with wine to enjoy the plums. The clear night is spotless, clouds break apart over two trees of jade blossom, and under sparse stars the frosty moonlight shines.

famous: 新月娟娟，夜寒江静山衔斗。

appreciation.zh-CN: 新月娟秀，夜寒江静，群山衔着北斗，窗前梅影清瘦，霜天清景宜人。
appreciation.en: A slender new moon hangs in the sky; the night is cold, the river still and the hills hold the Dipper in their teeth. Rising sleepless, the poet sees thin plum shadows on the window.

famous: 横玉叫清宵，帘外月侵残烛。

appreciation.zh-CN: 清宵笛声嘹亮，帘外月光侵入残烛，笛韵穿云，惊落小梅花粉，点点落在绿苔上。
appreciation.en: A jade flute sings through the clear night and moonlight slips past the curtain onto the guttering candle. The music soars, shaking pollen from the little plum blossoms onto the green moss.

famous: 水北烟寒雪似梅。水南梅闹雪千堆。

appreciation.zh-CN: 水北雪如梅，水南梅似雪，明月照着南北两座瑶台，恍如天上，清丽空灵。
appreciation.en: North of the water the snow looks like plum; south of the water the plum blossoms crowd like heaps of snow. Under the bright moon the two banks shine like twin jade terraces.

famous: 清绝。影也别。知心惟有月。

appreciation.zh-CN: 梅花受尽千霜万雪仍不怕寒，清绝脱俗，影子也与众不同，唯有明月是它的知己。
appreciation.en: Through a thousand frosts and ten thousand snows the plum endures, too lean and hardy to fear the bugle's blast. Its purity is matchless and even its shadow is unique; only the moon truly knows its heart.

famous: 守定南枝待得开，不觉冰轮动。

appreciation.zh-CN: 踏雪寻梅，守着南枝等花开，不知不觉月轮已移，雪光月色中梅韵清绝。
appreciation.en: Treading through snow to look for the solitary blossom, only poets keep it company. Waiting by the southern branch for it to open, they do not notice the icy moon wheeling across the sky.

famous: 月淡纱窗香暗透，白於纱。

appreciation.zh-CN: 腊前梅花素洁清香，淡月透过纱窗，花影比纱还白，幽人对花独酌，兴致无边。
appreciation.en: Before the twelfth month the plum blooms, pure white and delicately fragrant. Faint moonlight passes through the gauze window carrying its scent, the flowers whiter than the gauze, as a recluse drinks happily alone.
